description: The architectural 2D plan of a level as SVG text (walls cut at 1.2 m, doors and swings, dimensions in mm with chains through doors and windows, room names and areas, a north arrow). For a picture you can look at, use capture_view with mode "plan".

level.description: Level id or name (default: the active level)

scale.description: Drawing scale denominator, default 100 (1:100); US scales too, e.g. 48 for 1/4" = 1'-0"

name: get_plan_svg
title: Get plan (SVG)
